title: PolicySpec
description: The JSON-serializable form of an agent_safety policy — the same options as the safely(...) keywords. Load with PolicySpec.from_dict(); enforce with safely_from_spec(spec) or safely(**spec.to_kwargs()).

allow.description: Capability patterns the agent may use (glob * wildcards). Empty means allow everything the enclosing policy allows.

deny.description: Capability patterns to forbid even if allowed. Deny always wins.

calls.description: Most tool calls allowed in the block.

tokens.description: Most model tokens allowed (you report them via charge_tokens or metered()).

seconds.description: Total wall-clock time budget for the block, in seconds.

at_most.description: Most tool calls running at once (concurrency cap).

no_repeats.description: Stop after this many identical calls (runaway-loop breaker).

risk_budget.description: Cap on cumulative risk (tools declare risk=N weights).

budget.description: Money budget in dollars (pair with metered(call, model=...)).

timeout.description: Max seconds for any single call — stops hangs and deadlocks.

memory.description: Cap on Python-heap growth inside the block, in bytes.

max_input.description: Reject tool inputs longer than this many characters.

block.description: Regex patterns; matching tool inputs are rejected.

honeytoken.description: A planted canary secret; the run trips if it ever appears (exfiltration tripwire).

hide_secrets.description: Scrub emails / API keys / secrets out of tool results.

ask.description: Require approval before each action. In a spec this is the console prompt; pass a custom approver at runtime via safely_from_spec(spec, ask=fn).

explain.description: Capability patterns that require a rationale='...' argument. ['*'] means every call.

rules.description: Plain-English constitution rules. Require a judge= callable at runtime: safely_from_spec(spec, judge=fn).

monitor.description: Dry run: block nothing, log what WOULD be blocked.

log.description: Print every safety decision. Pass a custom sink at runtime via safely_from_spec(spec, log=fn).
